product.name: PatchPitch
product.description: A local writing studio turning selected release facts into editable announcements with source notes.

audience: Indie developers and open-source maintainers who write about their own projects
voice_reference: Editorial brief for owner review, not an author quotation: calm, concise, mildly personal. Explain a concrete engineering choice and its limits. No hype, invented metrics, forced emojis or generic AI marketing.

facts.text: PatchPitch is a local release-writing tool for indie developers and open-source maintainers. It uses Gemma through local Ollama.
facts.source_ref: main 55daab14470feaf489fc763a5c1e26fb078f1e37; review this fact before use

facts.text: The author selects which change notes to include before generation. Excluded notes never enter the model payload.
facts.source_ref: main 55daab14470feaf489fc763a5c1e26fb078f1e37; review this fact before use

facts.text: The author can inspect the cited original notes, edit the generated text, copy Markdown and download Markdown.
facts.source_ref: main 55daab14470feaf489fc763a5c1e26fb078f1e37; review this fact before use

facts.text: Source IDs aid inspection but do not prove that every sentence is factually correct. Human review is required.
facts.source_ref: main 55daab14470feaf489fc763a5c1e26fb078f1e37; review this fact before use

facts.text: The public GitHub Pages page shows a recorded product demo. It does not run live inference for visitors.
facts.source_ref: main 55daab14470feaf489fc763a5c1e26fb078f1e37; review this fact before use

facts.text: A delayed example load could overwrite input during generation. Reserving the example-loading operation through preparation fixed this race; regression tests cover success and failure.
facts.source_ref: main 55daab14470feaf489fc763a5c1e26fb078f1e37; review this fact before use

facts.text: Backup guidance validation was extended to the full devlog note. Citing the source alone is insufficient: Settings, device changes and clearing browser data must retain their actual circumstances. These are targeted checks, not semantic verification.
facts.source_ref: main 55daab14470feaf489fc763a5c1e26fb078f1e37; review this fact before use

facts.text: The code is MIT licensed and the Python application uses FastAPI and vanilla JavaScript.
facts.source_ref: main 55daab14470feaf489fc763a5c1e26fb078f1e37; review this fact before use

facts.text: [planned] Automatic Git import, direct social publishing and a hosted live writing service.
facts.source_ref: main 55daab14470feaf489fc763a5c1e26fb078f1e37; review this fact before use
